title: Cinema Prompting Studio
summary: Turn a scene you can picture into a video prompt. Direct the timing of a sequence in Sightline, compose a frame in FrameCraft, or explore camera choices in CinePrompt Studio.
summaryZhTW: 把腦中的畫面寫成影片提示詞。在 Sightline 編排鏡頭節奏、用 FrameCraft 設計構圖，或透過 CinePrompt Studio 探索攝影設定。
controls: Describe a scene, arrange timed beats, and copy or download the prompt.
limitations: Sightline composes prompts locally. FrameCraft and CinePrompt Studio use external scripts.

approval.note: Creator approved the app and neo-noir artwork for publication on Possibility.

coverAlt: Cinema Prompting Studio in cream lettering above an editor’s hands inspecting a filmstrip at a teal and amber vintage editing bench.
